description:
### Release v3.14.1

- Fix Custom Font & Modern Emoji patch class targeting for Gboard 18.0.3 (added `com.google.android.libraries.inputmethod.widgets.AutoCenterScaleTextView` alongside 18.4.1 `...widgets.text...`)
- Refined Emoji-only fallback to preserve stock typography when text is empty/initial
- Fully compatible with Gboard 18.0.3, 18.3.1, and 18.4.1
